definition: Whether a model's weights are downloadable and self-hostable (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral) or accessible only through an API (Claude, GPT, Gemini).
details: Whether a model's weights are downloadable and self-hostable (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral) or accessible only through an API (Claude, GPT, Gemini). "Open weights" is not the same as open source: training data and code often remain closed, and licenses may restrict use.
